STARSHIP

A closer look at a reusable spacecraft.

UPPER STAGE   /   V3 ARCHITECTURE
REFERENCE / 2026

A defined design snapshot.

This atlas represents the Starship upper stage, V3 architecture. Public envelope values are rounded figures from SpaceX’s design page, retrieved on 22 October 2026. Architecture changes follow the dated 12 May 2026 V3 update. It is not a drawing of a specific flight article.

Primary sources

  1. SpaceX · Starship design
    52 m upper-stage height; 9 m diameter; three sea-level and three vacuum engines.
  2. SpaceX · Introducing Starship V3, 12 May 2026
    Raptor 3, aft-system changes, flap actuation, reaction control and payload mechanism.

How to read the model

The exterior silhouette, four flaps, tiled windward side and six-engine arrangement anchor the illustration. Tank station lengths, bulkhead profiles, internal support hardware, docking-interface locations, pipe routes and tile pitch are schematic. No unpublished capacities, masses, pressures or exact internal dimensions are asserted.

The separated shells and welded tank sections explain adjacency. This is not a maintenance disassembly sequence. The payload rack is generic accommodation, not an exact PEZ-dispenser reconstruction.

Independent educational illustration. Not affiliated with or endorsed by SpaceX. All illustration geometry is drawn locally. No external resources are needed to operate this page.
EXPLORING THE ATLAS

One object. Several ways in.

Hover
Move over the ship to preview the separation. Leave the drawing to reassemble.
Drag / slide
Drag horizontally, or move the separation slider, to hold any intermediate state.
Click / tap
Select a visible component or an assembly in the list to lock its highlight and explanation. Click it again to release.
Filter
Choose a system to isolate its assemblies. Select any matching assembly for its relationships.
Keyboard
← → changes separation. ↑ ↓ previews modules. Enter locks selection. Space opens/closes. Home / End goes to 0 / 100%.
Reassemble
Esc or Reassemble clears the selection, filter and separation.
Inspect
Select an assembly, then use the magnifier to bring its geometry closer. Press it again for the whole vehicle.
Guided loop
The play button starts an optional slow tour. Any interaction stops it. Reduced-motion settings disable the loop.

On a phone, drag across the drawing to separate; vertical gestures keep scrolling the page. All operations are also available through the buttons and slider.
